title: Freeze native-scroll lease time in stale-focus microtask regression
outcome: The stale-focus microtask test proves a newer wheel owner survives older focus work without requiring a physical120ms lease to remain live.
acceptance: ui/src/message-stack-scroll-sync.test.ts test 'does not let a stale focus microtask overwrite a newer input' keeps real microtask ordering and exact wheel/down ownership assertion while controlling performance.now across the await.
The production lease duration, stale-focus fencing and input priority are unchanged; no timeout increase, retry or ignore.
